skills.title: BontaFlowStack driver
skills.description: Route a business, product, design, development or delivery task to a BontaFlowStack skill or resumable workflow. Use for choosing the next step or coordinating several requested steps.

skills.title: BFS implement
skills.description: Implement a plan, specification, selected design or scoped change explicitly accepted by the user. Use for building approved functionality and verifying its acceptance criteria.

skills.title: Business brief
skills.description: Clarify an idea, offer, customer problem or product direction and produce a testable business brief. Use for founder decisions and comparing practical approaches.

skills.title: Executable specification
skills.description: Turn an agreed request into a specification with behavior, scope, acceptance cases and implementation steps grounded in the actual project.

skills.title: Coordinated plan review
skills.description: Review a concrete plan through the relevant business, design, developer-experience and engineering perspectives, preserving decisions and unresolved findings.

skills.title: Business and scope review
skills.description: Review a plan for customer value, business fit, scope and practical success criteria. Use before committing effort to a product direction.

skills.title: Engineering plan review
skills.description: Check a plan's architecture, correctness, data handling, tests, performance and implementation readiness against the actual codebase.

skills.title: Design plan review
skills.description: Review planned screens and journeys for hierarchy, interaction states, consistency, responsiveness and accessibility before implementation.

skills.title: Developer interface plan review
skills.description: Review planned API, CLI, SDK, onboarding and error-recovery experiences. Use for developer-facing designs before implementation.

skills.title: Question preferences
skills.description: Inspect or change optional question preferences and declared profile values, review local question history, and propose or apply scoped adjustments.

skills.title: Design direction and variants
skills.description: Define a visual identity or design system, compare distinct design alternatives, and refine the selected direction for a website or product interface.

skills.title: Implement the design
skills.description: Build responsive HTML or a project-native component from a brief, selected design or image, then inspect the actual rendered result.

skills.title: Rendered design review
skills.description: Inspect a real interface for visual and interaction problems, optionally repair requested issues, and verify the affected output.

skills.title: Browser work
skills.description: Read and interact with a scoped web page, open a visible browser for human sign-in, and resume the same browser session.

skills.title: Structured page extraction
skills.description: Extract tables, products, listings or other specified fields from a real page into checked JSON, or answer from that page with sources.

skills.title: Page performance measurement
skills.description: Measure page performance, capture comparable baselines, and report regressions or trends from real browser samples.

skills.title: Investigate a reported defect
skills.description: Reproduce a bug or issue, trace the actual cause, and perform a requested focused repair with regression verification.

skills.title: Code change review
skills.description: Review a diff, patch or pull request for correctness, regressions and requirement coverage by tracing changed code and its callers.

skills.title: Security audit
skills.description: Audit a codebase or change for demonstrated security risks, trust-boundary failures and prioritized remediation.

skills.title: Project quality checks
skills.description: Run the project's existing tests, lint, type checks or build checks and report their actual results and limits.

skills.title: Web flow QA
skills.description: Test actual web interactions and responsive behavior, report reproducible defects, and optionally fix requested issues and retest them.

skills.title: Create and update documentation
skills.description: Create missing project documentation or update existing guides, references and release notes from verified source and actual behavior.

skills.title: Finish and deliver a change
skills.description: Prepare a verified change for delivery, review and documentation, then carry out the requested commit, push and pull-request operations.

skills.title: Integrate and deploy
skills.description: Merge or deploy an explicitly selected change using existing environment configuration, then verify the actual delivered revision and health.

skills.title: Delivery status
skills.description: Read a repository's integration queue, version claims and check freshness without changing Git or remote state.

skills.title: Project memory
skills.description: Read and maintain project decisions and learnings, search or export them, prune selected records, or explicitly import legacy notes.

skills.title: Save working context
skills.description: Create a manual local checkpoint of the goal, progress, decisions and remaining work, or list existing checkpoints.

skills.title: Restore working context
skills.description: Load a manual or automatic checkpoint, identify changed inputs and resume the requested work from a verified next step.

skills.title: Task protection
skills.description: Inspect or explicitly change destructive-command warnings and a project edit boundary for the current Codex task.

removed.skillify: Reusable browser automation generation and execution are unavailable; use one-time browse or scrape.
removed.devex-review: Runtime developer-experience auditing is unavailable. Plan review remains a separate capability.
removed.setup-deploy: Deployment configuration generation is unavailable. Provide existing configuration to prod-deploy.
removed.retro: Retrospective reporting was removed. Workflow progress remains available.
